title: Sallie Gardner at a Gallop
summary: A horse that gallops only while you scroll, quantized into Muybridge's twelve plates; stop, and it is a photograph again.
mechanism: Native scroll position is read live and quantized to 12 frames driving a deterministic kinematic gait on canvas — no autoplay, no timer, no stored frames; motion exists only in the act of scrolling.
references: Eadweard Muybridge, Sallie Gardner at a Gallop / The Horse in Motion (1878)
Martin Creed, Work No. 227 / y-a-v-a, The webpage going on and off (2023)
